workItem: Converge PR self-healing into one leading development chain and permanently eliminate the v1.8 hybrid baseline structure that caused PR #1298 Governance failure.

rootCause.architecturalCause: Two independently subscribed PR-body mutators owned different projections: PR Decision Evidence Reconciler and PR Production Baseline Auto-Refresh. Shared concurrency serialized writes but did not provide one structural contract.
rootCause.failedRecovery: repairLegacyPrBodyStructure.mjs did not allowlist the hybrid shape (machine details + NOT_RUN sentinel + trailing legacy H2 baseline), so the specialist writer failed closed with current-v1.8-unsupported-shape.

targetArchitecture.controller: PR Autofix Controller remains classifier/router only.
targetArchitecture.baselineRefresh: PR Production Baseline Auto-Refresh loses direct PR-body write authority and delegates PR convergence to the leading chain.
invariants: at most one PR body PATCH per convergence generation
v1.8 never emits legacy ## 7 baseline section
unsupported or ambiguous shapes remain fail-closed
no required-check weakening and no merge authority
